verdict.rationale: Opting out of tracking is a fair question for an analytics product, but the pack shows no user-level or global tracking opt-out. The related items are adjacent controls: element-level exclusion (heap-ignore), text-capture redaction (disableTextCapture), masking of sensitive data, and a user-deletion API. None of these stop telemetry or usage tracking for a user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
